Team,

Reminder: our weekly forecast sweep is today. I want to keep this tight — the goal is to lock commit/no-commit, reconcile any >$100K moves, and calibrate close dates for high-risk opportunities (primarily Acme Inc deal RDW-2026-ACME-47). Please do the following before our sync at 9:00 PT: 

1) Update CRM: stage, next step, confidence % and most recent customer signal.
2) Flag any deals that moved in the last 7 days and add a one-line reason (e.g., resource delay, procurement paperwork).
3) Attach any new redlines/POs to the deal record and add the filename to the comments.
4) If you plan to roll a deal out of commit, add a short justification in the commit-change field and ping me.

Agenda (20 min):
- 9:00–9:05: Quick roll call + current covered ARR
- 9:05–9:12: Top 5 deals at risk — each rep 1 minute (state change + risk mitigation)
- 9:12–9:17: Acme Inc deep-dive (Marcus) — procurement timing & SOW redlines
- 9:17–9:20: Decisions & action owners (who updates CRM, who follows procurement)

Prep doc: https://drive.redwood/Forecast/2026/Q4/weekly-template (please save a copy to the deal folder).

Attachments: weekly-forecast-template.xlsx (sheet per rep), commit-triage-notes.pdf (triage rubric)

Thanks — see you on the call.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
